```{r}
Idents(Tc_8) <- "celltype"
CD8 <- FindAllMarkers(Tc_8, min.pct = 0.2, logfc.threshold = 0.25, test.use = "MAST", only.pos = T)
```

## Dot
```{r}
helper_feats <- list(
  Naive = c("CCR7", "SELL", "LEF1", "TCF7"),
  Activation = c("CD40LG", "CD69", "CCL5", "IFNG", "CXCR4","TNF"),
  Cytotoxic = c("GZMB", "GNLY", "CX3CR1", "TBX21"),
  Treg = c("FOXP3","IL2RA","CTLA4"),
  Prolif = c("MKI67", "TOP2A", "STMN1")
)

Dot_4 <- seu_gene_sets_dot(Tc_4,
    helper_feats,                         # named list: list("Group A"=c("G1","G2(+)"), "Group B"=c(...))
    group_by = "celltype",              # meta.data column (like DotPlot(group.by=))
    assay    = NULL,                   # NULL => DefaultAssay(seu)
    use_scaled_for_fill = T,        # TRUE: fill = avg.exp.scaled; FALSE: avg.exp (raw)
    # aesthetics (DotPlot-like)
    size_range   = c(1, 5),           # bubble size range
    size_breaks  = c(1, 10, 100),  # % expressing
    size_limits  = c(0, 100),          # % expressing limits
    fill_limits  = c(-1, 1.5),           # when use_scaled_for_fill=TRUE
    fill_palette = c("blue", "lightgrey", "darkred"),
    x_label      = "",
    base_size    = txt_pt,
    x_angle      = 45,
    x_text_size  = txt_pt-2,
    y_text_size  = txt_pt,
    x_title_size = txt_pt,
    bracket_text_size = txt_mm,
    bracket_tick = 0.25,
    # layout/headroom controls
    y_expand_add_bottom = 0.60,        # add bottom padding (lifts dots off x-axis)
    y_expand_add_top    = 0.25,        # add top padding (reduces headroom)
    y_bracket_offset    = 0.80,        # bracket baseline above top row (in "row" units)
    y_label_offset      = 0.18,        # text above bracket baseline
    plot_margin_cm      = c(1.2, 0.6, 0.6, 0.6),  # top, right, bottom, left
    # NEW: clustering options
    cluster_groups = F,            # reorder rows (clusters) by hclut
    cluster_genes  = "within_group",
    dist_method    = "euclidean",
    hclust_method  = "complete") + theme(text = element_text(family = "Times")) + scale_y_discrete(limits = lvl_4, labels = lab_4)

cyto_feats <- list(

    size_breaks  = c(1, 10, 100),  # % expressing

    fill_limits  = c(-1, 1.5),           # when use_scaled_for_fill=TRUE
    fill_palette = c("blue", "lightgrey", "darkred"),
    x_label      = "",
    base_size    = txt_pt,
    x_angle      = 45,
    x_text_size  = txt_pt-2,
    y_text_size  = txt_pt,
    x_title_size = txt_pt,
    bracket_text_size = txt_mm,
    bracket_tick = 0.25,
    # layout/headroom controls
    y_expand_add_bottom = 0.60,        # add bottom padding (lifts dots off x-axis)
    y_expand_add_top    = 0.25,        # add top padding (reduces headroom)
    y_bracket_offset    = 0.80,        # bracket baseline above top row (in "row" units)
    y_label_offset      = 0.18,        # text above bracket baseline
```

#-----Changes in Representation------ {.tabset .tabset-pills .tabset-fade}
## Clusters
```{r}
df_4 <- Tc_4@meta.data  %>%
  dplyr::count(Tissue, celltype) %>%              # count combinations
  group_by(Tissue) %>%                      # within each celltype
  mutate(percent = 100 * n / sum(n)) %>%      # calculate %
  ungroup()

CD4_Percent <- ggplot(df_4, aes(x = Tissue, y = percent, fill = celltype)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", width = 0.9, color = "black") +
  labs(y = "Percent of cells",
       fill = "Cluster") +
  theme_pubr(base_family = "Times") +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, vjust = 1),
    axis.text   = element_text(size = txt_pt),
    axis.title  = element_text(size = txt_pt),
    legend.title = element_text(size = txt_pt),
    legend.text  = element_text(size = txt_pt),
    legend.position = "right",
    axis.title.x = element_blank()   # remove x-axis title
  ) + scale_fill_manual(values = cols$celltype) & NoLegend()


df_8 <- Tc_8@meta.data  %>%
  dplyr::count(Tissue, celltype) %>%              # count combinations
  group_by(Tissue) %>%                      # within each celltype
  mutate(percent = 100 * n / sum(n)) %>%      # calculate %
  ungroup()

# Find stacked bar boundaries for Cytotoxic clusters
cyto_boxes <- df_8 %>%
  dplyr::filter(grepl("Cytotoxic", celltype)) %>%
  group_by(Tissue) %>%
  summarise(
    ymin = sum(percent[celltype < celltype]) * 0,   # dummy placeholder
    ymax = sum(percent),                        # total % of cytotoxic sections
    ymin = 0,                                   # compute lower boundary correctly below
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# Actually compute ymin and ymax properly by stacking order
cyto_boxes <- df_8 %>%
  group_by(Tissue) %>%
  mutate(ymin = cumsum(percent) - percent,
         ymax = cumsum(percent)) %>%
  dplyr::filter(grepl("Cytotoxic", celltype)) %>%
  summarise(
    ymin = min(ymin),
    ymax = max(ymax),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# Draw bars + boxes
CD8_Percent <- ggplot(df_8, aes(x = Tissue, y = percent, fill = celltype)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", width = 0.9, color = "black") +
  labs(y = "Percent of cells", fill = "Cluster") +
  theme_pubr(base_family = "Times") +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, vjust = 1),
    axis.text   = element_text(size = txt_pt),
    axis.title  = element_text(size = txt_pt),
    legend.title = element_text(size = txt_pt),
    legend.text  = element_text(size = txt_pt),
    legend.position = "right",
    axis.title.x = element_blank()   # remove x-axis title
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = cols$celltype) +
  # Add dotted red rectangles over cytotoxic ranges
  geom_rect(
    data = cyto_boxes,
    aes(xmin = as.numeric(factor(Tissue)) - 0.45,
        xmax = as.numeric(factor(Tissue)) + 0.45,
        ymin = 100-ymin,
        ymax = 100-ymax),
    color = "red",
    linewidth = 2,
    linetype = "solid",
    fill = NA,
    inherit.aes = FALSE
  ) & NoLegend()
```

#-----Global Differential Gene Expression------ {.tabset .tabset-pills .tabset-fade}
## Plaque vs. Blood Volcano
```{r}
Idents(Tc) <- "PB"
Blood_Plaque <- FindMarkers(Tc, ident.1 = "Plaque", min.pct = 0.2, logfc.threshold = 0, only.pos = F, test.use = "MAST",
verbose = F)

Blood_Plaque$gene <- rownames(Blood_Plaque)
Blood_Plaque$Group <- ifelse(Blood_Plaque$avg_log2FC < 0, "Blood", "Plaque")

keyvals <- ifelse(Blood_Plaque$avg_log2FC < -0.25 & Blood_Plaque$p_val_adj < 0.0001, "grey", ifelse(Blood_Plaque$avg_log2FC > 0.25 & Blood_Plaque$p_val_adj < 0.0001, "#D7A2FF",
        'black'))
keyvals[is.na(keyvals)] <- 'black'
names(keyvals)[keyvals == '#D7A2FF'] <- 'Plaque'
names(keyvals)[keyvals == 'black'] <- ''
names(keyvals)[keyvals == 'grey'] <- 'Blood'

PB_Vol <- EnhancedVolcano(Blood_Plaque,
    lab = rownames(Blood_Plaque),
    caption = "",
    x = 'avg_log2FC',
    y = 'p_val_adj',
    title = "",
    subtitle = "",
    legendPosition = "none",
    FCcutoff = 0.25,
    pCutoff = 0.0001,
    boxedLabels = T, pointSize = 1, labSize = txt_mm - 1,
    drawConnectors = T,
    selectLab = c("SELL", "TCF7", "LTB", "LDHB", "S1PR1", "CCL4","CXCR4", "FTH1", "LDHA", "ICOS", "CD69"),
colCustom = keyvals) + scale_x_continuous(limits = c(-3.5, 3.5)) + scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 450)) +
  theme_pubr() + 
  NoLegend() + 
  theme(aspect.ratio = 1,
  text = element_text(family = "Times"),      
  axis.text.x = element_text(size = txt_pt), 
  axis.text.y = element_text(size = txt_pt), 
  axis.title.x = element_text(size = txt_pt), 
  axis.title.y = element_text(size = txt_pt),
plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 0)) +
ggtitle("Blood vs. Plaque")
```

## Unstable vs. Stable Volcano
```{r}
Idents(Tc) <- "Tissue"
Unstable_vs_Stable <- FindMarkers(Tc, ident.1 = "Unstable", ident.2 = "Stable", min.pct = 0.2, logfc.threshold = 0, only.pos = F, test.use = "MAST",
verbose = F)

Unstable_vs_Stable$gene <- rownames(Unstable_vs_Stable)
Unstable_vs_Stable$Group <- ifelse(Unstable_vs_Stable$avg_log2FC < 0, "Stable", "Unstable")

keyvals <- ifelse(Unstable_vs_Stable$avg_log2FC < -0.25 & Unstable_vs_Stable$p_val_adj < 0.0001, "#00C7CC", ifelse(Unstable_vs_Stable$avg_log2FC > 0.25 & Unstable_vs_Stable$p_val_adj < 0.0001, "#FA7F74",
        'black'))
keyvals[is.na(keyvals)] <- 'black'
names(keyvals)[keyvals == '#FA7F74'] <- 'Unstable'
names(keyvals)[keyvals == 'black'] <- ''
names(keyvals)[keyvals == '#00C7CC'] <- 'Stable'

Unst_Vol <- EnhancedVolcano(Unstable_vs_Stable,
    lab = Unstable_vs_Stable$gene,
    caption = "",
    x = 'avg_log2FC',
    y = 'p_val_adj',
    title = "",
    subtitle = "",
    legendPosition = "none",
    FCcutoff = 0.25,
    pCutoff = 0.0001,
    boxedLabels = T, pointSize = 1, labSize = txt_mm - 1,
    drawConnectors = T,
    selectLab = c("GNLY", "GZMB", "GZMH", "NKG7", "ZNF683","CD69", "ICOS", "KLF2"),
colCustom = keyvals) + scale_x_continuous(limits = c(-3, 4)) + scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 350)) +
  theme_pubr() + 
  NoLegend() + 
  theme(aspect.ratio = 1,
  text = element_text(family = "Times"),      
  axis.text.x = element_text(size = txt_pt), 
  axis.text.y = element_text(size = txt_pt), 
  axis.title.x = element_text(size = txt_pt), 
  axis.title.y = element_text(size = txt_pt),
plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 0)) +
  ggtitle("Stable vs. Unstable")  # Add your title here

```

#-----All Unique vs. Common DEGs - Top 50 Heatmap------ {.tabset .tabset-pills .tabset-fade}
```{r}
# Set tissue identifier
Idents(Tc) <- "Tissue"

groups <- c("Blood", "Stable", "Unstable")

Unique_vs_Common_Graph <- get_unique_and_common_degs(
  seu          = Tc,
  groups       = groups,
  ident_col    = "Tissue",        # change if your column is called something else
  unique_groups= c("Blood", "Stable", "Unstable"),
  common_sets  = list(
    c("Unstable", "Stable")),
  min.pct        = 0.25,
  logfc.threshold= 0.2,
  pval_cutoff    = 0.05,
  test.use       = "MAST"
)
```


```{r}
Idents(Tc) <- "Tissue"
Tc.Avg <- AverageExpression(Tc, assays = "RNA", slot = "scale.data", return.seurat = T)
```

```{r}
Heatmap_Genes <- Unique_vs_Common_Graph %>% group_by(cluster) %>% top_n(100, wt = avg_log2FC)
Heatmap_Genes$Num <- rownames(Heatmap_Genes)

mtx <- Tc.Avg@assays$RNA@layers$scale.data
mtx <- as.data.frame(mtx)
colnames(mtx) <- colnames(Tc.Avg)
rownames(mtx) <- rownames(Tc.Avg)
         
        

mtx_sub <-subset(mtx, rownames(mtx) %in% Heatmap_Genes$gene)
x <- Heatmap_Genes$gene
mtx_sub <- mtx_sub[, c(2,3,1)]
mtx_sub <- mtx_sub %>% arrange(factor(rownames(mtx_sub), levels = x))

meta <- Tc.Avg@meta.data
meta$cluster <- rownames(meta)
meta <- meta[c(2,3,1),]

# Set up annotations for rows and clusters
# genes you want to label
genes_to_label <- c("TCF7", "SELL", "LEF1", "LDHB", "IL16", "S1PR1", "CD52", "KLRG1", "CD27",
                    "ATF3", "TNFSF9", "KLRB1", "AHR", "CD28",
                    "CXCR3", "HLA-DR", "GZMB", "TGFBR3", "GZMM", "GNLY", 
                    "CCL4", "CXCR4", "BHLHE40", "GZMK", "RUNX3", "ICOS", "CCL5", "CD69", "GZMA", "CD96", "CD44")   # <-- edit this

# find their row indices in the heatmap data
lab_idx <- which(Heatmap_Genes$gene %in% genes_to_label)

# sanity check (optional)
Heatmap_Genes$gene[lab_idx]

labels <- rowAnnotation(
  x = anno_mark(
    at = lab_idx,
    labels_rot = -30,
    labels_gp = gpar(fontsize = txt_pt, fontfamily = "Times"),
    padding = unit(2.5, "mm"),
    labels = Heatmap_Genes$gene[lab_idx],
    side = "left"
  )
)

cluster_anno <- HeatmapAnnotation(
  cluster = meta$cluster,
  show_annotation_name = FALSE,
  annotation_label = FALSE,
  annotation_name_rot = 5,
  show_legend = FALSE,
  annotation_legend_param = list(labels_gp = gpar(fontsize = 0)),
  col = list(cluster = cols$Tissue[2:4])
)

# Create row annotations using HeatmapAnnotation
right_annotation = rowAnnotation(anno = anno_block(gp = gpar(fill = cols$Tissue[2:5]),
        labels = c("Blood Unique", "Stable Unique", "Unstable Unique", "Plaque Common"), labels_gp = gpar(col = "white", fontsize = txt_pt,fontfamily = "Times"), labels_rot = -90))

# Set up heatmap colors and legend
col_fun <- colorRamp2(c(-0.5, 0, 0.5), c("blue", "#EEEEEE", "red"))
heatmap_legend_params <- list(
  legend_direction = "horizontal",
  legend_width = unit(3, "cm"),
  labels_gp = gpar(fontsize = txt_pt,fontfamily = "Times"),
  labels_rot = -90,
  title = "",
  title_gp = gpar(box_fill = "grey"),
  at = c(-1, 0, 1)
)

# Draw heatmap
HM <- Heatmap(
  mtx_sub,
  height = nrow(mtx_sub)*unit(0.5, "mm"),
  width = ncol(mtx_sub)*unit(5, "mm"),
  border = TRUE,
  top_annotation = cluster_anno,

  row_names_gp = gpar(fontsize = 0),

  col = col_fun,
  cluster_rows = TRUE,
  cluster_columns = FALSE,
  show_row_dend = FALSE,
  cluster_row_slices = FALSE,
  show_column_names = FALSE,
  cluster_column_slices = FALSE,
  split = Heatmap_Genes$cluster,
  column_names_side = NULL,
  row_title = " ",
  heatmap_legend_param = heatmap_legend_params)

svglite("../docs/assets/01-Figure-1/Gene_Heatmap.svg", width = 3, height = 11)
draw(HM, heatmap_legend_side = "bottom")
```

#-----Cluster Specific Unstable vs. Stable------ {.tabset .tabset-pills .tabset-fade}
```{r include=FALSE}
Idents(Tc) <- "celltype"

## Scale and normalise RNA check
DefaultAssay(Tc) <- "RNA"

groups <-  levels(Tc)

# Store results
deg_results <- list()

for (g in groups) {
  message("Running DEG for: ", g)
  
  # Subset cells of this TRDV group
  Tc_sub <- subset(Tc, idents = g)
  Idents(Tc_sub) <- "Tissue"   # Tissue must contain Plaque/Blood
  
  # Run DEG (Plaque vs Blood)
  deg <- FindMarkers(
    Tc_sub,
    ident.1 = "Unstable",
    ident.2 = "Stable",
    min.pct = 0.2,
    logfc.threshold = 0.25,
    test.use = "MAST",
    only.pos = F
  )
  
  # Add cluster info and gene names
  deg$cluster <- ifelse(deg$avg_log2FC > 0, "Unstable", "Stable")
  deg$gene <- rownames(deg)
  deg <- subset(deg, p_val_adj < 0.05)
  
  # Save to list
  deg_results[[g]] <- deg
}

all_deg_Unst_list <- deg_results
all_deg_Unst <- bind_rows(deg_results, .id = "celltype")
rownames(all_deg_Unst_list) <- NULL
deg_results <- NULL

plot_levels <- lvl[-c(1,6,7,11)]

counts_plot_Unst <- count_and_plot_deg_lollipop(
  deg_list        = all_deg_Unst_list,
  contrast_levels = c("Unstable","Stable"),
  pval_col        = "p_val_adj",
  lfc_col         = "avg_log2FC",
  alpha           = 0.05,
  lfc_thresh      = 0.25,
  font_family = "Times",
  txt_pt = 10,
  pt_size = 2,
  aspect = NULL,
  palette = cols$Tissue
) + theme(text = element_text(family = "Times", size = txt_pt)) + scale_y_discrete(limits = rev(plot_levels), labels = lab)
```

## Create Plots
### Unstable vs. Stable Expression Bubble 
```{r, fig.width=10}
## Genes to Plot
gene_sets <- list(
  `Migration` = c("ITGA4", "ITGA5", "ITGB1", "LSP1", "TAGLN"),
  differentiation = c("CD44", "HOPX", "ID2", "ZEB2", "ZNF683"),
 `inhibitory signalling` = c("PTPRCAP", "CD5", "SLA", "SLA2", "CD6", "TNFAIP3", "NFKBIA"),
  Metabolism = c("TXNIP", "ALDOA", "CPT1A", "TUFM"),
  Cytotoxicity = c("GNLY", "GZMB", "GZMH", "PRF1", "KLRD1", "FGFBP2","NKG7"))

deg_counts <- all_deg_Unst %>%
  dplyr::filter(cluster == "Unstable",
         avg_log2FC > 0.25)  %>%
  group_by(gene) %>%
  summarise(n_cells = n()) %>%
  ungroup()

deg_plot <- subset(all_deg_Unst, celltype %in% plot_levels)
deg_plot$regulation <- deg_plot$cluster
deg_plot$cluster <- NULL
deg_plot$celltype <- factor(deg_plot$celltype, levels = rev(plot_levels))

levels(deg_plot$celltype)

Unstable_Dot <- seu_gene_sets_dot(
  seu = NULL,
  markers_df = deg_plot,
  markers_gene_col  = "gene",
  markers_group_col = "celltype",
  markers_lfc_col   = "avg_log2FC",
  markers_padj_col  = "p_val_adj",
  gene_sets = gene_sets,
  group_by = "celltype",
  assay    = NULL,
  use_scaled_for_fill = TRUE,
  show_missing = TRUE,
  size_range   = c(1, 12),
  size_breaks  = c(1, 50, 100),
  size_limits  = c(0, 40),
  fill_limits  = c(-1.5, 1.5),
  fill_palette = viridisLite::viridis(3),
  x_label      = "",
  base_size    = txt_pt,
  x_angle      = 45,
  x_text_size  = txt_pt,
  y_text_size  = txt_pt,
  x_title_size = txt_pt,
    bracket_text_size = txt_mm,
  bracket_tick = 0.25,
  y_expand_add_bottom = 0.60,        # add bottom padding (lifts dots off x-axis)
  y_expand_add_top    = 0.25,        # add top padding (reduces headroom)
  y_bracket_offset    = 0.40,        # bracket baseline above top row (in "row" units)
  y_label_offset      = 0.18,
  plot_margin_cm      = c(1.2, 0.6, 0.6, 0.6),
  cluster_groups = F,
  cluster_genes  = "none",
  dist_method    = "euclidean",
  hclust_method  = "complete"
) + theme(text = element_text(family = "Times")) + scale_y_discrete(limits = rev(lvl_plot <- lvl[-c(1,6,7,11)]
), labels = lab) + theme(
    legend.position = "bottom",
    legend.direction = "horizontal"
  )

Unstable_Dot

```
